title: The Theorem of Pythagoras
seo_title: Grade 8 Theorem of Pythagoras Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Investigate the relationship between the lengths of the sides of a right-angled triangle to develop the Theorem of Pythagoras; determine whether a triangle is a right-angled triangle or not if the length of the three sides of the triangle are known; use the Theorem of Pythagoras to calculate a missing length in a right-angled triangle, leaving irrational answers in surd form.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 8 Pythagoras worksheets: finding the hypotenuse and shorter sides, testing for right angles and problems. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • In a right-angled triangle, the hypotenuse c is the longest side, opposite the right angle.
  • Theorem of Pythagoras: c² = a² + b².
  • For a shorter side: a² = c² − b².
  • If c² = a² + b², the triangle has a right angle.

Examples

Example

Sides 9 cm and 12 cm

c² = 81 + 144 = 225

Answer: c = 15 cm

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding for a short sideSubtract: a² = c² − b².
No square rootc² = 225 means c = 15.
The wrong cc is the longest side.
